name: superstables
description: Discover paid services, quote them and pay from your own wallet: testnet demo
long_description: Superstables lets an agent find an x402 paid service, ask it what a call costs, and pay for it with test USDC on Base Sepolia. The key stays in your browser wallet: when the agent asks to pay, it gives you a link to an approval page on your own machine, which shows the amount, asset, network and recipient it derived from the seller's own payment requirement, and MetaMask signs only what you approve. Every quote, attempt, approval and receipt is written to ~/.superstables. Testnet only, so no real money moves.

wallet_url.title: Wallet address (URL)
wallet_url.description: Where the local wallet process listens, when that mode is used instead of a browser wallet. It must stay on the loopback interface.

tools.name: find_services
tools.description: Search for paid services that can be quoted and paid, and say which ones this client can actually call.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Ask a paid endpoint what one call costs. Nothing is signed and nothing is paid.

tools.name: pay
tools.description: Pay a quote: the owner is asked to approve in their wallet, and the service is called only if they do. Returns the link they have to open.

tools.name: payment_status
tools.description: Wait for, and report, the state of a payment attempt.

tools.name: wallet_status
tools.description: Report which wallet signs on this machine, and its address, network, balance and policy.

tools.name: list_receipts
tools.description: List the receipts of payments that settled on this machine.
